pairs.evidence: src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:229 In these files 'gate' only names sign-in, org-access, credit and quota admission for a report read or scan, and the tests are behaviour specs, so nothing renders a verdict on a change or an advancing item; a search of src/app/report and src/components/report for reference-transaction, pre-receive and branch-provenance found nothing, and a search of the context's files for ratchet and waiver found nothing either.

techniques.evidence: src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:128 Separates a failed read from an empty one for display; no policy condition is being evaluated, so this is the neighbouring measurement-honesty concern.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.tsx:159 A role probe that hides UI affordances; there is no severity level or exit-code path to trace.
src/components/report/ReportClient.tsx:86 A product paywall shown to an end user, not a blocking check's refusal to a contributor.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/opengraph-image.doors.test.ts:108 An ordinary behaviour spec with a control case; it does not guard a convention over a population.
src/app/report/[owner]/[repo]/page.unreachable.test.tsx:126 Asserts on one rendered failure state of this page, not a source-pattern gate over the tree.

pairs.registryProposal: The golden path defines a gate as a mechanism that can refuse, but does not say when an ordinary unit test counts as one. Seats must decide this per context, so a line separating a behaviour spec from a convention guard over a population would make verdicts on product-UI contexts more consistent.

pairs.subject: quality-gates
pairs.evidence: src/app/portfolio/page.test.tsx:119 The context's one convention check judges only elements whose author added data-portfolio-copy, so a new sentence containing an em dash and no attribute passes while the test still reports that new copy carries none; no such sentence exists today, so this is a coverage hole rather than a live violation.

techniques.evidence: src/app/portfolio/page.test.tsx:119 The judged population is enrolled by hand with an attribute the gated author writes, instead of being derived from the rendered page with data glyphs excluded; not enrolling is free.
src/app/portfolio/page.test.tsx:117 The pass names the property (new copy has no em dash) when it establishes only that no tagged element has one: a floor reporting as a ceiling.
src/app/portfolio/page.test.tsx:120 Asserts the instrument found something, so an empty selection cannot pass. This covers the empty-population floor only; no seeded red case is in the suite.

src/app/portfolio/PortfolioTable.tsx:12 This no-data glyph is correct content that a whole-body read would flag; leaving it out keeps the check from firing on it, though opt-in is what creates the hole recorded above.
src/lib/org/portfolioBookModel.ts:86 Skips an unmeasured dimension when naming the weakest for display; nothing is refused on it.
src/app/portfolio/page.tsx:38 'Gated' here is per-org read authorization, with no gate policy described across surfaces.
